summary: This bill exempts H-1B visa applicants working in healthcare from a presidential proclamation that restricts the entry of certain nonimmigrant workers and imposes an additional fee, ensuring they only pay the standard H-1B fee.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly addresses H-1B visas for healthcare workers, exempting them from certain restrictions and fees imposed by a presidential proclamation. This would make it easier for these specific nonimmigrant workers to enter the U.S., thus increasing a particular type of immigration.
